text:
Two different things here, so I'll break it down:

**The 6 nav/agent-library PRDs (917–922, "Agent Library" work)** — done. All archived as completed (`prds-archived/`, plus mirrored in the epic's own `prds-archived/`), and `HEAD` (`481cef1`) is 1 commit ahead of the `v0.48.0` release tag which is already published — so that work is both merged and shipped to npm (`0.48.0` local == `0.48.0` on npm registry).

**The "Builder to NPX" epic (`psess-msase2q4-1`)** — not done. It's still `status: active`, and the last event in it is the agent asking you two open design questions (trigger mechanism: cron vs. push-triggered; and bump/gate policy) that haven't been answered yet. Nothing has been built for it.

If "is this done?" meant the Builder-to-NPX epic, it's still waiting on your answers to those two questions before any implementation starts.
